ink.note: Dark ground (the stockbook page), text on paper and on amber.

ground-dark.note: Dark-mode page ground. Same value as Ink.

ground-light.note: Light-mode page ground, under a faint 24px quadrille grid. Never warmed toward cream.

paper.note: Stamp paper and the paper panel in both themes.

fog.note: Primary text on the dark ground; text on ink plates.

silver.note: Secondary text on the dark ground.

slate.note: Reviso's structural mark colour. Fails AA as text on the grey ground.

slate-deep.note: Secondary text on the grey ground and on paper.

amber.note: The studio's ink: the diamond's dot, the postmark, primary buttons, focus rings on dark surfaces. Constant across themes; never used by a product.

amber-text-light.note: Amber that must read on light surfaces: the focus ring on the grey page and on paper, amber text in light mode.

field-sixteen.note: The deep field Sixteen to One's stamp prints on, in both themes.

field-pica.note: The deep field Pica's stamp prints on, in both themes.

field-stockpot.note: The deep field Stockpot's stamp prints on, in both themes.

field-bramble.note: The deep field Bramble's stamp prints on, in both themes.

field-wiffletree.note: The deep field Wiffletree's stamp prints on, in both themes.

field-reviso.note: The deep field Reviso's stamp prints on, in both themes.

crema.note: Sixteen to One's accent: the stamp's band, its status marker and colour-bar square. Never body text on the ground.

cobalt.note: Pica's accent: the stamp's band, its status marker and colour-bar square. Never body text on the ground.

tomato.note: Stockpot's accent: the stamp's band, its status marker and colour-bar square. Never body text on the ground.

vivid-violet.note: Bramble's accent: the stamp's band, its status marker and colour-bar square. Never body text on the ground.

sea-glass.note: Wiffletree's accent: the stamp's band, its status marker and colour-bar square. Never body text on the ground.

electric-cyan.note: Reviso's accent: the stamp's band, its status marker and colour-bar square. Never body text on the ground.

display.purpose: The hero line only ("Small by design."). Archivo at wdth 125.

headline.purpose: Section and page headings, sentence case. Archivo at wdth 118.

title.purpose: Product names in catalogue rows, taglines, principle titles. Archivo at wdth 112.

body.purpose: Reading text, 17px, measure at most 68ch. Archivo at wdth 100.

stamp-label.purpose: Printed matter only: text on a stamp, issue lines, sheet margins, form labels. Not an eyebrow over every section.

code.purpose: Real commands only: install lines and slash commands.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: A stamp or sheet at rest on the dark page. A filter, so it follows the perforations. Light mode: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgb(12 14 26 / 0.18)) drop-shadow(0 14px 22px rgb(12 14 26 / 0.16)).

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: A stamp picked up (hover or focus). Light mode: drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgb(12 14 26 / 0.18)) drop-shadow(0 20px 26px rgb(12 14 26 / 0.24)).

shadows.name: print
shadows.purpose: Real photographic material only: the mounted Wiffletree screenshot and the Sixteen to One screens.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Every authored transition: stamp lift, button press, arrow step, fade-in, postmark landing.

motion.name: stamp-lift
motion.purpose: A stamp lifting 6px with a -1.4deg turn when picked up.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes on buttons and links.

motion.name: postmark-land
motion.purpose: The site's one authored moment: the postmark lands on the hero sheet. Static under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Stamp
components.description: A product printed as a stamp: perforated paper, the product's deep field, issuer line, mark, name, platforms and the accent band. Lifts and tilts when it is a link and is picked up.
components.html: Vyttle05WiffletreemacOS
components.css: .ds-stamp { --r: 4.5px; container-type: inline-size; position: relative; display: block; width: 200px; padding: calc(var(--r) * 2.7); background: radial-gradient(var(--r), #0000 96%, #F7F7F4) round calc(var(--r) * -1.5) calc(var(--r) * -1.5) / calc(var(--r) * 3) calc(var(--r) * 3), linear-gradient(#F7F7F4 0 0) no-repeat 50% / calc(100% - var(--r) * 3) calc(100% - var(--r) * 3); color: #F7F7F4; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45)) drop-shadow(0 18px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45)); transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-stamp:hover, .ds-stamp:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-1.4deg); filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4)) drop-shadow(0 22px 28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55)); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4933D; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-stamp__field { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; padding: 7cqw 7cqw 0; background: var(--field); } .ds-stamp__issuer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112; font-weight: 640; font-size: 6cqw; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(247 247 244 / 0.8); } .ds-stamp__number { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 62%, #F7F7F4); } .ds-stamp__mark { display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-stamp__name { display: block; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112; font-weight: 720; font-size: 8.6cqw; line-height: 1.02; } .ds-stamp__meta { display: block; margin-top: 2.4cqw; font-size: 5.4cqw; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: rgb(247 247 244 / 0.72); } .ds-stamp__band { display: block; height: 5.5cqw; margin: 6cqw -7cqw 0; background: var(--accent); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Studio amber with ink text, 6px radius, no pill. The page's main action; amber is the studio's ink, so a product never recolours it.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 108; font-weight: 640; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #D4933D); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn--primary { background: #D4933D; color: #0C0E1A; border: 1px solid #D4933D; } .ds-btn--primary:hover { background: #E3A552; border-color: #E3A552; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline outline in the ground's text colour. Sits beside a primary button; the border firms up on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 108; font-weight: 640; font-size: 15px; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary, #DDE0E8); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(168, 173, 189, 0.34)); transition: border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--text-primary, #DDE0E8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #D4933D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Arrow Link
components.description: Text link with a hairline underline that turns amber and an arrow that steps forward on hover. Catalogue rows and product particulars.
components.css: .ds-link-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 108; font-weight: 620; color: var(--text-primary, #DDE0E8); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--border-strong, rgba(168, 173, 189, 0.34)); text-underline-offset: 5px; transition: text-decoration-color 200ms ease; } .ds-link-arrow:hover { text-decoration-color: #D4933D; } .ds-link-arrow span { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-link-arrow:hover span { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-link-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #D4933D); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Issue Line
components.description: The catalogue line for an issue: a square accent marker, the catalogue number, then status and platforms in printed label type. Status is printed text, never a glowing badge.
components.html: No. 02  · Coming soon  · iPhone & Android
components.css: .ds-issue { font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112; font-weight: 620; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.9; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-secondary, #A8ADBD); } .ds-issue__marker { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-right: 8px; background: #4A6FE0; } .ds-issue__no { color: var(--text-primary, #DDE0E8); }

components.name: Command Box
components.description: A real install command on an ink plate (the same in both themes, so its focus ring stays amber), faded at the right edge where it scrolls, with a copy button.
components.html: $curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vyttle-LLC/wiffletree/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
components.css: .ds-cmd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; max-width: 460px; padding: 6px 6px 6px 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: #07080F; border: 1px solid rgb(168 173 189 / 0.2); color: #DDE0E8; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; } .ds-cmd__prompt { color: #D4933D; } .ds-cmd__code { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto; white-space: nowrap; padding: 8px 24px 8px 0; scrollbar-width: none; mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 calc(100% - 28px), transparent); } .ds-cmd__copy { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(221 224 232 / 0.08); color: #DDE0E8; font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 640; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cmd__copy:hover { background: rgb(221 224 232 / 0.14); } .ds-cmd__copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4933D; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Support-form input: printed label above, a sunk field with a firm hairline, 16px text so iOS never zooms, focus ring in --focus-ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 360px; font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112; font-weight: 620; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-secondary, #A8ADBD); } .ds-field__input { font: inherit; font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(168, 173, 189, 0.34)); background: var(--surface-sunk, rgba(221, 224, 232, 0.035)); color: var(--text-primary, #DDE0E8); transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; } .ds-field__input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #D4933D); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--focus-ring, #D4933D); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Fixed translucent bar: the diamond and the outlined VYTTLE wordmark (artwork, never live text), Apps, Open source, Support, theme toggle, and a perforated bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 40px; min-width: 640px; height: 64px; padding: 0 40px; background: var(--nav-bg, rgba(12, 14, 26, 0.88)); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); font-family: var(--font-archivo), Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; border-bottom: 6px solid transparent; border-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--border-strong, rgba(168, 173, 189, 0.34)) 1.6px, transparent 2.1px) 0 0 100% / 0 0 6px repeat; } .ds-nav__brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--text-primary, #DDE0E8); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 28px; } .ds-nav__links a { color: var(--text-secondary, #A8ADBD); text-decoration: none; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 108; font-weight: 560; font-size: 15px; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav__links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #DDE0E8); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #D4933D); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Vyttle is one issuing studio with a family of small products, and every product mark is built from the same grammar as the Vyttle diamond: a flat geometric body, a cut circle, one accent dot. That is exactly how a modernist stamp issue works — Wim Crouwel's Dutch PTT numerals, the Swiss PTT definitives — one authority, one frame, one construction system, a different colour per value.

So the site is a stamp issue. The lineup is a perforated sheet. Each product is a stamp printed in its own deep field with its mark at the centre and its accent as a printed band. A shipped app carries an amber postmark with its month of issue; everything else is honestly unissued. The pages around the sheet behave like the rest of the philatelic world: a catalogue that lists each issue with its number and status, a stockbook page that holds them, and the printed reverse of the sheet for the studio's principles.

The world is strictly modernist. No aged paper, no grunge, no sepia, no vintage cancellation texture. Flat ink, exact perforation, wide grotesk lettering, precise registration marks.
keyCharacteristics: The stamp is the product's unit everywhere: hero sheet, catalogue entries, product pages, nav and menus (as a perforated chip).
Colour lives in the stamps. Each stamp's field and accent band are saturated, so the sheet carries six colours at page scale while the ground stays neutral.
Amber is the studio's ink: the diamond's dot, the postmark, the primary action.
Type is one family, Archivo, used across its width axis — expanded for display, normal for reading, slightly wide for printed labels — like a postal lettering system.
Motion is philatelic: a stamp lifts off the page when picked up; a postmark lands once.

rules.name: The Studio Ink Rule
rules.body: Amber belongs to Vyttle: the diamond dot, the postmark, the primary button, focus rings. A product never uses amber, and amber never prints inside a product field except as the postmark that cancels it.

rules.name: The Constant Star Rule
rules.body: The diamond's dot is `#D4933D` in every theme and size.

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: Keyboard focus is a 2px `--focus-ring` outline: amber on the dark page, Amber Dark `#7E5414` on the grey page, where raw amber is only 2.1:1. The ring follows the surface, not the theme: Amber Dark on the paper panel in both themes (amber is 2.4:1 on paper), amber on ink plates in both themes.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Text Rule
rules.body: Two text tones per theme. Dark: Fog primary, Silver secondary. Light: Ink primary, Slate Deep `#454B60` secondary (Slate fails AA on the grey ground). Hierarchy comes from size, width and weight.

dos: Show every product as a stamp built by the one `Stamp` component.
Keep status honest: postmark only for shipped apps; "Coming soon", "In development", "Planned", "Early release" as printed text.
Use real screenshots only (Sixteen to One, Wiffletree). Other products are represented by their stamps.
Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: no lift rotation, no postmark landing.
Keep the site free of analytics, pixels, embeds and runtime third-party requests.
donts: Don't age anything: no paper texture, sepia, coffee stains, torn edges or grunge cancels.
Don't put a tracked uppercase eyebrow over every section. Printed stamp labels belong to printed things.
Don't use cards with icon + heading + text as page structure; use catalogue rows.
Don't use glass, gradients or glows as decoration.
Don't use amber inside a product's page except as its postmark; don't use a product accent on Vyttle's own chrome.
Don't fabricate social proof, prices, ship dates or user counts.
